scenes.text: Canva just built its own *image AI*, and it can spell

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 22: Canva launched Canva Craft, its first image model, trained on millions of human-made Canva templates instead of photos.
Up to 2K, 30-plus sizes, text in 55 languages. Magic Layers turns the image into editable text and objects.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Printables and posters sell on Etsy, and clients pay for social graphics. The old blocker: AI images with garbage text.
Prompt: "Vintage coffee shop poster, Open 7am, bold cream lettering on dark teal." Fix any letter in Canva, export at 2K.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Canva's 'fourth best image model' claim comes from DesignArena, a community vote, not an independent test. Proof every letter before you sell.
Check Canva's AI content terms before listing anything. Source: Canva newsroom and TechCrunch, Oct 22, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Every Canva account worldwide, free plan included, in the Dream Lab tab.
Canva has not published a credit cap for Craft. Expect your plan's AI limits to apply.
